# Dual-Track Attack Corroboration Dashboard
**The same attack, confirmed by two independent methods** - Kerberos log analytics (behavioural) AND LSASS memory forensics (the actual forged ticket). Log-only SIEM shows an *inference*; this shows the *artifact*.

---

content.query: let win=24h; let logTrack=SecurityEvent | where TimeGenerated>ago(win) | where EventID==4769 | extend Acct=tostring(extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]+)<',1,EventData)) | where isnotempty(Acct) | extend AccountName=tostring(split(Acct,'@')[0]) | summarize LogEvents=count() by AccountName; let memTrack=VolatilityAnalysis_CL | where TimeGenerated>ago(win) | where riskLevel_s=='CRITICAL' | extend Detail=tostring(parse_json(kerberosAnalysis_indicators_s)[0].description) | extend AccountName=tostring(extract(@'account\(s\) \[([^\]]+)\]',1,Detail)) | extend LifetimeDays=toint(extract(@'([0-9]+)-day',1,Detail)) | where isnotempty(AccountName) | summarize MemDetections=count(), MaxLifetimeDays=max(LifetimeDays) by AccountName; logTrack | join kind=inner memTrack on AccountName | extend Verdict='CONFIRMED - Log + Memory' | project Account=AccountName, LogTrack_TGS_4769=LogEvents, MemoryTrack_Detections=MemDetections, ForgedTicketLifetimeDays=MaxLifetimeDays, Verdict
content.title: Golden Ticket confirmed by BOTH the log track and the memory track (same account)

content.json: ## 2. The two tracks, side by side

content.query: SecurityEvent | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where EventID==4769 | extend Account=tostring(extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]+)<',1,EventData)) | extend Service=tostring(extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]+)<',1,EventData)) | where Account startswith 'Administrator' | project TimeGenerated, Account, Service | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 12
content.title: TRACK 1 - LOG EVIDENCE: TGS requests (4769) = behavioural signal (an inference)

content.query: VolatilityAnalysis_CL | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where riskLevel_s=='CRITICAL' | extend Detail=tostring(parse_json(kerberosAnalysis_indicators_s)[0].description) | extend TargetAccount=tostring(extract(@'account\(s\) \[([^\]]+)\]',1,Detail)) | extend LifetimeDays=toint(extract(@'([0-9]+)-day',1,Detail)) | extend RecoveredTicket=extract(@'"file":\s*"([^"]+\.kirbi)"',1,kerberosAnalysis_indicators_s) | project TimeGenerated, TargetAccount, LifetimeDays, RecoveredTicket | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 12
content.title: TRACK 2 - MEMORY EVIDENCE: the recovered forged ticket + 10-year lifetime (the artifact)

content.query: SIDHistoryInventory_CL | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) and RiskLevel_s=='HIGH' | project TimeGenerated, Account=ObjectName_s, SIDHistory=SIDHistoryEntry_s, Risk=RiskLevel_s | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 10
content.title: SIDHistory - HIGH-risk privileged SIDs detected via inventory

content.query: union (SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where Title has 'Golden Ticket' | summarize Incidents=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend Detection='Golden Ticket (Log)'),(SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where Title has 'SIDHistory' | summarize Incidents=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend Detection='SIDHistory (Inventory)'),(SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where Title has 'Volatility' | summarize Incidents=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend Detection='Memory Forensics') | project Detection, Incidents
content.title: Incidents by detection path (24h)
